name: Purple Knight
what: A free assessment tool that checks Active Directory, Entra ID and Okta for indicators of exposure and compromise and gives a scored report.
when: For a second opinion next to PingCastle, especially if you run hybrid identity with Entra ID.
example: Download Purple Knight from the Semperis website.
Run it from an admin workstation and choose which environments to assess.
Review the report by category and by severity of each indicator.
Fix the highest-impact indicators first and run the tool again to compare scores.
pitfalls: It is an assessment, not continuous monitoring.
Indicators of compromise need investigation, not just a settings change.
Compare findings with other tools; they weight risks differently.
